name: cortex-agent
description: VS Code extension for Cortex Hub — real-time agent orchestration via WebSocket conductor

cortexHub.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key for Cortex Hub authentication. Resolution order: this setting, then `CORTEX_HUB_API_KEY` / `HUB_API_KEY` / `CORTEX_API_KEY` env vars, then MCP configs (Claude Code, `.mcp.json`, Gemini, Antigravity, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code).

cortexHub.hubUrl.markdownDescription: Cortex Hub conductor WebSocket URL. Resolution order: this setting, then `CORTEX_HUB_WS_URL` / `CORTEX_HUB_URL` env vars, then MCP configs (Claude Code, `.mcp.json`, Gemini, Antigravity, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code), then `ws://localhost:8318/ws/conductor`.

cortexHub.agentId.markdownDescription: Agent identifier sent to the conductor. Defaults to `<hostname>-vscode`.

cortexHub.capabilities.markdownDescription: Agent capabilities to register with the conductor.

cortexHub.autoConnect.markdownDescription: Automatically connect to Hub on startup.

scripts.release: npm version patch && npm run build && npm run package
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run build && npm run package
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run build && npm run package
